description: Benchmark requirements for the n-Queens Completion analysis system. The system generates random partial queen placements, determines satisfiability via SAT, counts exact solutions, and analyzes phase transitions.

solution_counts.description: counter.count() must return these exact values for the given instances

sat_verdicts.description: solver.solve() must return correct satisfiability for instance files in /app/instances/

encoder_performance.description: The SAT encoder must scale efficiently with board size

phase_transition.description: Phase transition analysis of satisfiability as constraint density varies
phase_transition.format: CSV with header 'm,sat_fraction', one row per m value from 1 to 13

constraints.trend: sat_fraction must decrease overall from low m to high m
